description.value: At 10th level, whenever the chemist would administer or hit a creature with an alchemical item that successfully applies or removes an effect or status effect, he can set off a chemical chain reaction to affect an additional nearby creature. Any healing or damage that is part of an alchemical item's effect does not spread. The chemist may affect one additional creature at 10th level, gaining an additional creature to affect thereafter every fourth level after 10th, no two of which can be more than 20 feet apart. A chain reaction cannot occur off of another chain reaction.
